trigger_criteria: Entity IDs exposed to external APIs or generated across distributed nodes
decision_rationale: UUIDv7 provides k-sortable B-tree locality, eliminates enumeration attacks, and avoids centralized sequence generation bottlenecks.

trigger_criteria: Application-level status and state machine transitions in microservices/web applications
decision_rationale: Plain strings with application validation allow rolling zero-downtime deployments and safe rollbacks without DB lock acquisition.

trigger_criteria: High-contention updates where multiple users may edit the same record simultaneously
decision_rationale: Optimistic locking avoids holding database connection locks during user network/think time, preventing connection pool exhaustion.

trigger_criteria: Compliance, financial audit trails, or dispute resolution requirements
decision_rationale: Append-only audit tables preserve the complete historical delta (who, when, what) without cluttering current operational state.

trigger_criteria: Modifying a column name or type on a production database with live traffic
decision_rationale: Expand-contract guarantees that both the old version of the app and new version can operate concurrently during deployment.

trigger_criteria: Data with predictable relational query attributes vs truly dynamic third-party payloads
decision_rationale: 3NF relational columns provide schema enforcement, query planner statistics, and efficient indexing; reserve JSONB for truly unstructured payloads.
